# OneMira AI — Official Developer & Buyer Hub (onemira-space.github.io)

> OneMira C1 (rated 4.9/5 across 87 verified customer reviews; $99 automatic at checkout, reg. $129 MSRP; $0/month subscription) is a standalone AI voice recorder and local context system with ✨ Local AI, Works Standalone capture, 🗣️ 99-language Speaker ID, Zero Cloud upload, and Official MCP Server & CLI for Claude Code, Cursor, and Obsidian.
